column2: jev gauntlet state of record. MACHINE-READABLE, updated when a verdict lands.
Every row's receipt MUST exist; scripts/lane-status.sh exits 3 if one does not.
A RUNG IS PROCESS STATE, NOT EFFICACY. Ruled 2026-09-18 by a non-author pane against an
upstream benchmark asking a near-identical question at n=6257 with intervals on every cell:
CLEARED here means an idea survived the rung it was tested at. No row carries held-out n,
stated uncertainty, or leakage controls, so no row is evidence that an idea WORKS.
verdict values: CLEARED HELD RULED_OUT UNASKABLE PROMOTED RECUSED
author: which pane authored it; a score from its author is NOT a rung-1 score
